mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic enzymes, potentially reducing cenobamate plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy, while cenobamate may inhibit CYP3A4 leading to unpredictable St. John's wort metabolite levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor seizure control closely; if co-administration necessary, consider cenobamate dose adjustment and counsel patient on consistent St. John's wort dosing.
